name: Aranjuez Cultural Landscape
description: Aranjuez, a town on the Tagus River south of Madrid, grew up around a royal estate founded by Philip II in 1560. Over three centuries, Spanish monarchs shaped its palace, geometric French-style Baroque gardens, tree-lined avenues and river-fed woodlands into a green retreat. Until 1752 only royalty and nobility were allowed to live there, so you can still stroll through a carefully planned royal getaway.
